label: Auto number
description: A human-friendly, system-assigned record number such as TCK-000123, made of a prefix and a zero-padded sequence. Numbers are unique per tenant environment and entity and are used in titles, notifications, and search. Use it as the entity's reference number, not as a primary key.
usage: Give every work entity one auto number with a 2–6 letter prefix (TCK, INC, VND).
Show it in list columns and headers; people quote it on the phone.
Never ask users to type it; it is always read-only.
constraints: prefix is required: 2–6 uppercase letters or digits, starting with a letter.
Assigned by the platform on create as <prefix>-<sequence>, zero-padded to 6 digits and growing past 999999.
The sequence is per tenant environment and entity; numbers are never reused, but gaps can occur.
Always system and read-only: it cannot be set by the record API, imports, rules, or AI. Changing prefix affects new records only.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Not editable. In lists and headers the number is part of the record link.
accessibility.notes: Read as plain text exactly as stored (e.g. TCK-000123) so it can be quoted; a copy button is named "Copy number".

responsive: Fixed width in monospaced digits at all sizes.
